TASK: Preserve the AI-generated question draft separately from the instructor's edited version. Executable assignment, not a context handoff.

WORKTREE (work ONLY here): C:/Users/basqu/Projects/quest-on.grade-provenance
Branch: feat/grade-provenance. The migration already exists at `database/028_grade_provenance.sql` (columns: `exams.ai_draft_questions jsonb`, `exams.ai_draft_generated_at timestamptz`).

=== THE BUG ===
`exams.questions` is one JSON blob that gets fully overwritten on every save. When the AI generates questions and the instructor then edits them, the original AI draft is gone, so nobody can tell what the instructor actually changed.

=== WHAT TO BUILD ===
When AI-generated questions are first committed into an exam (the moment `exams.questions` is first populated from an AI generation), also store that generated payload into `exams.ai_draft_questions` with `ai_draft_generated_at`. After that, subsequent edits to `questions` must NEVER modify `ai_draft_questions`.

=== ORDER OF WORK (mandatory) ===
This touches existing behavior:
STEP 1 — baseline characterization test that PASSES on unchanged code, pinning that a `questions` update overwrites the stored value wholesale. Capture it passing.
STEP 2 — failing-first test `__tests__/ai-draft-preservation.test.ts` asserting (i) first commit populates `ai_draft_questions`, (ii) a later `questions` update leaves `ai_draft_questions` byte-identical, (iii) a re-generation does NOT overwrite an existing `ai_draft_questions`. Capture it failing for the right reason.
STEP 3 — smallest production change to turn it green.

=== FILES IN SCOPE ===
- `app/api/ai/generate-questions/route.ts`
- `app/api/ai/generate-questions-stream/route.ts` — this is an SSE route using `ReadableStream`; its `finally { controller.close() }` is around lines 324-326. If you persist anything here, it MUST be awaited BEFORE `controller.close()`. An unawaited promise is frozen when the response completes on this deployment target, which is silent data loss.
- `app/api/supa/handlers/exam-handlers.ts` (around lines 321-400, the `questions` update path, note the existing `updateWithoutRubric` pattern)
- `app/api/supa/handlers/assignment-handlers.ts` (around lines 279-305, `updatePayload.questions = questions`)

=== MUST NOT ===
- Do NOT connect to any database. No `psql`, `supabase` CLI, `prisma migrate`, seed or cleanup scripts. Hard project stop-rule. Mock the Supabase client in tests.
- Do NOT read `.env.local` or any `.env*` file.
- Do NOT store a full edit history — exactly ONE AI draft per exam, the first one.
- Do NOT change the SSE response shape or the event protocol of the streaming route.
- Do NOT touch `exams.rubric` (legacy, deliberately excluded from updates).
- Do NOT edit files outside the scope list. Do NOT add an npm dependency.
- Do NOT add `Co-Authored-By`. Do NOT push.

=== VERIFY (paste real output for each) ===
1. `npx vitest run __tests__/ai-draft-preservation.test.ts`
2. `npx tsc --noEmit`
3. `npm run lint`
4. `git status --short`

=== MANUAL-QA (required) ===
Data-shaped change, so the auxiliary surface counts. Write a throwaway node script under `/tmp` that prints the exact update payload your code now sends for (a) first AI commit and (b) a later instructor edit. Run it and paste both. Binary observable: (a) contains `ai_draft_questions` and `ai_draft_generated_at`; (b) contains neither key at all (not present, not null). Delete the script and paste the `rm` receipt.

=== ADVERSARIAL CLASSES to probe and report ===
- stale_state: prove a second generation does not clobber the stored draft — name the test.
- misleading_success_output: paste real command output; a green suite that never exercised the streaming route is not coverage — show which test covers it, or state plainly that the streaming path is covered only by the non-streaming test and why that is acceptable.
- dirty_worktree: `git status --short` before and after.

=== COMMIT ===

-- 028: AI 제안 점수·문항 초안 보존 컬럼
--
-- 현재 grades.score와 exams의 문항 내용은 AI 제안과 교수자 확정 값이 같은 컬럼에 덮어쓰기되어
-- 변경 추적이 불가능하다. 이 마이그레이션은 AI 제안 값을 별도로 기록해 감사(audit)와
-- 비교 분석을 가능하게 한다.

BEGIN;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. grades: AI 제안 점수와 교수자 확정 점수 분리
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 현재 grades 테이블의 score 컬럼은 row-wide upsert로 업데이트되어,
-- AI 제안 값과 교수자 확정 값이 같은 공간을 덮어쓴다.
-- 따라서 "AI가 제안한 점수가 정말 무엇이었나"를 추후에 복구할 수 없다.
-- ai_proposed_score와 ai_proposed_at를 기록해 두면 점수 변경의 전체 히스토리를 추적할 수 있고,
-- "교수자가 제안과 얼마나 다르게 점수를 주었는가"를 분석할 수 있다.
-- ai_proposal_source는 어느 시스템(모델명, 버전 등)에서 나온 제안인지 기록한다.
ALTER TABLE grades
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_proposed_score numeric;

ALTER TABLE grades
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_proposed_at timestamptz;

ALTER TABLE grades
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_proposal_source text;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. exams: AI 초안 문항 내용 별도 보존
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 현재 exams 테이블의 문항 내용(예: questions 컬럼)은 JSON blob으로 저장되는데,
-- AI가 생성한 초안과 교수자가 최종 확정한 문항이 같은 컬럼을 덮어쓴다.
-- 따라서 "원본 AI 제안이 정확히 무엇이었는가"를 나중에 확인할 수 없다.
-- ai_draft_questions는 AI가 생성한 초안 문항을 별도로 보존하고,
-- ai_draft_generated_at은 그 생성 시점을 기록해 버전 관리와 감사를 가능하게 한다.
ALTER TABLE exams
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_draft_questions jsonb;

ALTER TABLE exams
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_draft_generated_at timestamptz;

COMMIT;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 롤백
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ALTER TABLE grades DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS ai_proposed_at;

Done. Commit `9bdf2b11964c9e78bf6fe77ca693e57ba642a1bb`.

## Key finding that shaped the design

Both AI routes are **pure generators** — `generate-questions/route.ts` and `generate-questions-stream/route.ts` never touch the database. They have no `examId` and no Supabase import; they return questions to the client, which later commits them via `update_exam` / `update_assignment`. So the only place `exams.questions` is ever written is the two handlers.

I also could not add a client-sent `aiGenerated` flag: `updateExamSchema` and `updateAssignmentSchema` are both `.strict()` (an extra key is a hard 400), and `lib/validations.ts` plus the instructor pages are outside the scope list. Provenance therefore had to be inferred server-side, which the spec's own wording licenses — "the moment `exams.questions` is first populated". The rule is: write the draft only when the stored draft is null **and** current questions are empty **and** the incoming array is non-empty.

## Adversarial classes
- **stale_state** — covered by `(iii) 재생성은 이미 저장된 ai_draft_questions 를 덮어쓰지 않는다`. It models the nastiest ordering: instructor deletes every question (so `questions` is empty again, which would otherwise re-trigger "first population") then regenerates. The `ai_draft_questions != null` guard is the load-bearing one; the test compares `JSON.stringify` before/after to prove byte-identity.
- **misleading_success_output** — stating it plainly: **the streaming route has zero test coverage here, and zero production change.** It persists nothing, so there was nothing to await before `controller.close()`; the SSE event protocol and response shape are untouched. Coverage lives entirely at the handler layer because that is the only layer that writes to `exams`. A green suite here is honest only because the streaming route is genuinely not on the write path — not because I mocked it away.
- **dirty_worktree** — clean before, clean after commit (both pasted above).

Not applicable: **malformed input** — handler inputs are already zod-validated upstream and the helper coerces non-arrays via `Array.isArray`; **prompt injection** — no prompt or model output is consumed by this change; **cancel/resume** — no long-running or resumable operation added; **hung commands** — every command finished well under timeout; **flaky tests** — the new tests are pure synchronous payload assertions with no timers or sleeps (the two transient failures in the first full-suite run were pre-existing 5s-timeout flakes in `student-disclosure-ack.test.ts` on a cold 52s transform cache, in files that never call the changed handlers; green on re-run and in isolation); **repeated interruptions** — single uninterrupted session.

Closing this properly needs an `aiGenerated` flag threaded through `lib/validations.ts` and the instructor pages, both out of scope. (2) Both handlers now `select` `ai_draft_questions`, so migration 028 must be applied before deploy or those selects error — note `createExam` has a precedent comment about exactly this hazard for `is_demo`.
